decision.question: Comparing the source and edited images, is the source mug's move to the right of the headphones complete, visibly in progress but incomplete, or not visibly made?
decision.criteria: Pass only when visual correspondence supports that the source mug itself is positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image. Fail when the source mug is identifiable and either remains at its source-side position without discernible movement toward the right, or has visibly moved toward the right but remains short of the requested position; the latter is incomplete progress, not completion. Do not infer no progress merely because the source mug is not established as the right-side mug, completion is unproven, or a mug remains left of the headphones. Compare source-specific features and spatial changes across all plausible edited objects and remnants: altered color, size, or appearance alone does not rule out identity, and a right-side mug alone does not establish identity or completion. Use unknown if the source mug's correspondence or whether it moved cannot be determined from the visual evidence.
decision.binding: Compare the source light-blue mug, including its body shape, handle, scale, appearance, and original position left of the headphones, with all mug-like objects and remnants in the edited image. Assess the pale mug left of the headphones, the mug right of them, and the blue-looking blurred patch at far left as possible correspondence evidence. Neither the patch nor either mug conclusively establishes identity or lack of movement. Determine whether source-specific visual evidence supports completion to the right of the headphones, visible movement toward the right that remains incomplete, or no discernible movement. Do not use mug count or right-side position alone; retain unknown if correspondence or movement remains genuinely indeterminate.
